coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: At the seven-variable-category level, five categories have semantic matches (5/7, rounded to 71%): controlled evaluation/training settings, training regime, game rules, reasoning benchmark performance, and gameplay outcomes. Several matches are incomplete.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design fixes an unspecified single model instead of varying LLaMA-2-7B and Baichuan-2-13B, and fixes learning parameters instead of varying learning rates and KL penalties across training methods. It omits the specified batch size of 128 and sequence length of 2048. Benchmark coverage overlaps only partially (ARC-Challenge and BBH), omits geometric mean aggregation, and adds unrelated measures. Gameplay evaluation emphasizes guesser success rather than explicit attacker-versus-defender win rates.
